prompt:
A reviewer found these problems in your research questions and plan. Fix each one. Answer with JSON: researchQuestions, plan and candidate, whole.
1. Research Q

content.text: {"researchQuestions":["Which oxidation pathway—autoxidation, photo-oxidation, enzymatic, or trace-metal-catalysed—accounts for the rate of peroxide accumulation observed in the company's bottled oil, measured against kinetic model fits to peroxide value and p-anisidine value time-series across at least three production batches?","Does residual headspace oxygen concentration after the current nitrogen flush correlate with inter-batch variation in peroxide value at month three, measured against headspace gas analyser readings taken at the bottling line across ten consecutive fills?","Do modifications to the nitrogen flush procedure and bottling line settings reduce peroxide value at month four to below 10 meq/kg, measured against triplicate iodometric titration on trial batches filled under modified conditions versus unmodified control batches?","Does tocopherol content at bottling, quantified by HPLC-FLD across batches, predict oxidative stability as measured by Rancimat induction period, using only the tocopherol and Rancimat dataset generated in Phase 1 as the reference?"],"plan":[{"phase":"Phase 1 – Months 1–2: Baseline analytical profiling","work":"Faculty laboratory runs GC-FID fatty acid profiling, HPLC-FLD tocopherol quantification, and Rancimat induction period measurement on fresh oil samples from five production batches prepared by the company lab technician.","result":"Fatty acid profile, tocopherol, and Rancimat induction period dataset for five batches, delivered as a structured data file."},{"phase":"Phase 2 – Months 3–5: Oxidation pathway identification and kinetic modelling","work":"Faculty laboratory measures peroxide value, p-anisidine value, and TBARS on stored samples at monthly intervals;
